main.description: Public webhook metadata stored in the user's PDS. Links to a private io.atcr.hold.webhook record on the hold where URL and secret are stored. Part of a two-record split: this record is visible via ATProto (Jetstream), the hold record is not.

createdAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the webhook was created

holdDid.description: DID of the hold where the webhook is configured

privateCid.description: CID of the corresponding io.atcr.hold.webhook record on the hold

updatedAt.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when the webhook was last updated
